description: No first-order theory in the one-relation language has exactly the nonempty connected symmetric irreflexive relations as its models.
signature:

  ¬∃ T,
      ∀ (M : Type) (x : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.language.Structure M),
        Nonempty M →
          (M ⊨ T ↔
            Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.ConnectedRelation Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.edge)
